Nina: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to converge actor/permissions across org/project API keys and service principals. TL;DR: default-deny, explicit role mappings, and ephemeral delegated tokens for services. PTAL @Sam @Alex
Sam: high-level looks good. main worry is migration churn and metrics we need to watch for (401s, token-exchange failures).
Alex: agree. also worried about auth latency if we add runtime policy evals on every call. need cache strategy or push decisions into infra. :thinking_face:
Jorge: for migration we could shadow-map old api-keys -> roles and run in read-only mode for 30 days, then flip. minimizes breakage.
Priya: +1 on shadowing. We should add a bulk remap tool in console (CSV import) and a staged deprecation banner for org admins.
Nina: proposed rollout plan (short):
1) land policy schema v2 (explicit role bindings)
2) implement token-exchange endpoint for svc principals -> short-lived bearer tokens
3) deploy shadow-mapping proxy for legacy api-keys (no behavioral changes)
4) enable canary enforcement by org via feature flag
Code example for check side:
```
// pseudocode
if (auth.header.startsWith("svc-")) {
  token = exchangeSvcToken(auth.header)
  allowed = rbac.check(token.actor, resource, action)
} else {
  // legacy api-key path (shadow) -> map to role id
  role = shadowMap.lookup(apiKey)
  allowed = rbac.check(role, resource, action)
}
```
Alex: that pseudocode shows the hot path. cache rbac.check results keyed by (actor, resourcePrefix, action) with ~30s TTL to avoid DB blowup. Also, local KMS calls for token exchange should be batched or offloaded to a token service.
policy-bot: Reminder: policy schema v2 was merged to main 2 days ago. Validation webhook is available in staging.
Sam: metrics to add: auth_p95_latency, auth_5xx_rate, token_exchange_errors, shadow_mismatch_count. We'll need dashboards and alert thresholds before canary.
Jorge: for backward compatibility: proxy could issue ephemeral tokens on first request and cache them by api-key, expire after X. That reduces changes to callers.
Priya: canary deployment idea: pick 3 orgs (one small, one medium, one enterprise) and run shadow + opt-in enforcement. We'll surface a migration checklist in console and email admins.
Nina: agreed. action items: I will draft migration playbook + RFC appendix; Sam add dashboards/alerts; Alex prototype caching/token-service; Jorge build proxy shim; Priya define org communication + console UX.
Sam: timeline? think 4 weeks for an internal pilot if we prioritize.
Nina: sounds reasonable. I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to lock dates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
